purpose: Teach: ちがう/浮い/曲げ/騒い/脱い/滑り/冷やし/返せ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、それ、本気で、絶対、ちがう、絶対、お紙、絶対、よ
lines.en: Sho — that's the wrong paper, absolutely.
lines.style: Gentle correction, warm and patient. Light touch on the reassurance. Speaking to a 6-year-old who needs clarity without shame.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お風呂で、本気で、絶対、浮い、絶対、てたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I really did float in the bath, I promise.
lines.style: Bright, earnest excitement. A small child proving something he's proud of. Quick, genuine laugh underneath. Eye contact seeking.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お背中、本気で、絶対、曲げ、絶対、ないで姿勢よくね
lines.en: Sho — don't hunch your back. Keep your posture nice and straight, okay?
lines.style: Tender instruction, not commanding. A sister noticing something small and caring enough to mention it. Warm, unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お友達と、本気で、絶対、騒い、絶対、で、絶対、楽しかったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I had so much fun playing with my friends, it was really loud and rowdy!
lines.style: Animated, bouncy energy. A 6-year-old reliving the joy of it. Words tumble out. Whole-body enthusiasm barely contained.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、ジャケット、本気で、絶対、脱い、絶対、で椅子に置いてね
lines.en: Sho — take off your jacket and hang it on the chair, please.
lines.style: Simple, clear direction delivered with affection. Not hurried. The voice of someone making sure he's looked after.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、雨で、本気で、絶対、滑り、絶対、やすいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — it's slippery outside because of the rain, you have to be careful.
lines.style: Quiet, observant concern. A 6-year-old noticing a real hazard and sharing it seriously. Soft, genuine worry underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、冷やし、絶対、たお茶、絶対、お父さんに、絶対、お持ちしてね
lines.en: Sho — bring that chilled tea to your dad for me, would you?
lines.style: Warm, simple request. A sister asking a favor of him like he's capable and trusted. Gentle, unhurried pace.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、メイ姉さんに、本気で、絶対、返せ、絶対、てない、絶対、本、絶対、まだあるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I still have some books I haven't returned to you yet.
lines.style: Slight wry honesty, a little sheepish. A 6-year-old admitting something he knows he should've done. Small, genuine smile in the voice.
